rationale:
I found no test-adequacy gap for `requirements.sdk.graph.agent-harness.OllamaConfig`. I did not read implementation source. The review rests on the supplied test text.

Obligations and the tests that cover them:
- **Constructor and builders.** `new` sets only `model`. `endpoint`, `api_key_env`, `api_key` and `option` each set only their own field. A repeated `option` key replaces the earlier value. `config.rs#mod[tests]/fn[backend_builders_set_only_the_requested_fields]` checks all of this through the serialized JSON. It checks `new` alone gives `{"model":...}`. It checks the full builder chain gives the exact endpoint, key env, key and options `{a:2,b:true}`.
- **Serialize and Deserialize.** `config.rs#mod[tests]/fn[all_backends_preserve_nested_settings_and_credentials]` deserializes an Ollama `AgentConfig` that carries `api_key_env` and nested options. It asserts that re-serialization equals the input. It also checks a string round-trip.
- **PartialEq and Debug.** The same test compares `AgentConfig` values with `assert_eq!`. That needs `PartialEq` and `Debug` on the nested `OllamaConfig`.
- **Clone.** No test calls `Clone` on `OllamaConfig`. It is a compile-time trait with no behavior beyond a derive. I treat this as not a gap.
- **Endpoint default, credentials and options.** `config.rs#mod[tests]/fn[option_defaults_and_credential_resolution_are_deterministic]` covers these:
  - the default endpoint is `http://localhost:11434`;
  - there is no key when none is configured;
  - an `api_key_env` that is absent from the environment gives an error naming the variable;
  - an explicit `api_key` is resolved;
  - an Ollama options map holding NaN is rejected.
- **Requests to the server.** `configured.rs#mod[tests]/fn[supplied_ollama_backend_delivers_tools_and_results_over_native_chat]` runs against a local server. It asserts that the request goes to the configured `endpoint` at `/api/chat`. It asserts the `Authorization: Bearer local-ollama-key` header. It asserts `model` equals `local-ollama`. It asserts `options.num_predict` equals 256. This shows `model`, endpoint, credentials and options configure the requests.
- **Public API and `#[non_exhaustive]`.** `tests/public_api.rs#fn[public_exports_match_the_appendix]` covers the public export inventory. The `#[non_exhaustive]` attribute has no runtime behavior to test.

text: `model` names the model on the Ollama server. The endpoint, credentials, and inference options configure requests to that server.
pub fn endpoint(self, endpoint: String) -> Self;
pub fn api_key_env(self, api_key_env: String) -> Self;
pub fn api_key(self, api_key: SecretString) -> Self;
pub fn option(self, key: String, value: OptionValue) -> Self;
